+4.9% day-over-day move (z-score 2.21) on 2019-12-16. Reason given by 1 report from that day:
- "Coffee futures prices have the biggest one - day surge since 2015" (cnbc.com, 2019-12-16). Reported move: up 7%. Reason: supply shortage in the largest producer. Quote: "as a supply shortage in the largest producer drove up the prices" (source: 6058eb8c07e28f7a)
